candidates.name: Spire Global

candidates.name: UiPath, Inc.

candidates.name: Pegasystems Inc.

candidates.name: Klaviyo, Inc.

NYSE, ~$5B cap, ~23-28% growth, 110% NRR. Co-moves with the AI-SaaS application sleeve.

candidates.name: Tempus AI, Inc.
candidates.why: AI-native applications company (Data & Applications segment +40%, AI-enabled Next/Lens platforms) applying models to healthcare to generate revenue — the same AI-native-app return driver as SOUN/DUOL. candidates.name: Innodata Inc.

candidates.name: Brown & Brown, Inc.

candidates.name: W. R. Berkley Corporation
candidates.why: Among the largest US commercial-lines P&C and specialty/E&S writers with a reinsurance segment, a direct underwriting-cycle peer to CB, TRV and ACGL. candidates.name: Willis Towers Watson Public Limited Company
candidates.why: Global insurance broker and risk-and-broking advisory firm, the fourth major broker alongside basket members MMC, AON and AJG. candidates.name: Everest Group, Ltd.
candidates.why: Major global reinsurer plus primary P&C/specialty insurer, directly exposed to reinsurance pricing, rate-on-line and reserve adequacy across the hard-vs-soft cycle, the same driver as reinsurance/specialty member ACGL. ~$13B cap, NYSE, long history. High co-movement.

candidates.name: Kinsale Capital Group, Inc.
candidates.why: Pure-play excess & surplus (E&S) specialty P&C insurer, a high-purity hard-market and underwriting-cycle play whose growth and combined ratio track the same dynamics the basket monitors. ~$7B cap, NYSE, multi-year history. candidates.name: Amgen Inc.
candidates.why: World's largest pure-play biotech and a top PPH constituent. Direct peer to the existing big-biotech members (GILD, BIIB, REGN, VRTX) with the same branded-pipeline/patent-cliff/M&A return driver. Nasdaq-listed, large-cap, highly liquid.

candidates.name: AstraZeneca PLC

candidates.name: Novo Nordisk A/S (ADR)
candidates.why: GLP-1/obesity-diabetes leader and a top PPH holding; direct head-to-head peer of Eli Lilly. Liquid NYSE ADR with multi-year US trading history. Branded-drug pipeline progress and pricing dynamics make it co-move tightly with the large-cap drug complex.

candidates.name: GSK plc
candidates.why: Large-cap branded pharma (vaccines, HIV, respiratory, oncology) and a PPH constituent. Listed directly on the NYSE (not just an ADR), liquid and >$1B cap. Shares the patent-cliff/pipeline/drug-pricing return driver of the core members, so it co-moves with the basket.

candidates.name: Herc Holdings Inc.

candidates.name: DXP Enterprises, Inc.

candidates.name: Ferguson Enterprises Inc.

candidates.name: Genuine Parts Company
